findings.title: Flex layout breaks right-aligned small-action button
findings.body: Adding `@include flexbox()` to `.small-action` changes its children to flex items. The existing `.small-action button { float: right; }` rule (line 309) can no longer right-align a button that is a direct flex child because floats are ignored on flex items. Also, `.small-action-desc` is not given `flex-grow`, so it no longer spans the remaining row width; if the button is nested inside it, the internal float will no longer push the button to the full row’s right edge either. The undo/act action button will therefore sit next to the description instead of at the right side. Add `margin-left: auto` to the button or make `.small-action-desc` grow.

findings.title: align-items mixin omits -moz-box-align fallback
findings.body: The new `align-items()` mixin emits `-webkit-box-align`, `-webkit-align-items`, `-ms-flex-align`, and `align-items`, but omits `-moz-box-align`. Since the new `flexbox()` and `inline-flex()` mixins explicitly fall back to `display: -moz-box`/`display: -moz-inline-box`, old Firefox versions will select the legacy box display but ignore the requested alignment. Add `-moz-box-align: $alignment;` for parity; the `-ms-align-items` declaration is not a recognized IE property and can be removed.
